approval_required_for: Any architecture or pipeline topology change, including adding, removing, or reordering stages, changing residual skip sources, branch/join fire rules, or stream/data edge ordering.
Any attention semantic change, including GQA head counts, group size, RoPE policy, causal mask policy, head_dim, or sequence-length bound.
Any numeric policy change, including activation bits, weight bits, scale bits, accumulator bits, rounding, saturation, tolerance, or golden-output policy.
Any substitution of trusted templates, major template-library changes, or free-form RTL generation outside an approved bounded repair boundary.

Any memory-layout or runtime-protocol change, including concrete DDR base-address assignment, six-region memory layout, AXI data/address/WSTRB width, 64-byte alignment, XDMA device index, control/status apertures, raw register/DDR protocol, or double-buffered weight/activation ping-pong policy.
Any change to target sequence length, hidden size, intermediate size, stream lane count, or transfer-count policy that alters memory/runtime quantities or model-shape consistency.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop before retry or downstream consumption to avoid artifact contamination.
executable_actions.rationale: The command failed with returncode 1 and the existing pipeline_planning_report is stale, incomplete, and explicitly not promoted. A trust barrier prevents downstream contamination while allowing same-stage diagnostic use of logs.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote; retain the failed-attempt barrier and route the new evidence to localized failure escalation/backtrack handling.
executable_actions.rationale: Attempt 1 of 2 failed at the current-stage architecture gate. With no open SACG backtrack or contamination barrier blocking retry, regenerate/refine the pipeline planning contract from the source SACG state; use failed-attempt outputs only as diagnostics to resolve the 4 unresolved risks.

executable_actions.on_failure: Reject or revise the retry candidate without promotion; do not hide protected deltas inside a same-stage retry.
executable_actions.rationale: The retry is allowed to repair the current-stage contract, but any change to protected architecture, attention, numeric, memory/runtime, board/runtime protocol, or template policy requires approval before promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not proceed to parameter_binding; because this would consume the second bounded attempt, create localized failure evidence and request backtrack or stop.
executable_actions.rationale: Candidate retry artifacts may supersede failed same-stage artifacts only after all current-stage checks pass and the retry reconciliation contract proves the stale report is not being promoted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop autonomous progression and preserve all failed artifacts as diagnostics only.
executable_actions.rationale: If the permitted retry also fails, the bounded attempts for pipeline_planning are exhausted. The team must localize the unresolved current-stage blockers and request backtrack rather than loop or contaminate downstream stages.
